sets.title: Formation Drill
sets.description: Form past passive participles from perfective verbs

items.explanation: Short form predicative: написано (neuter, agrees with письмо).

minimalPairs.context: _____ книга лежит на столе. (attribute before noun)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The read book is on the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: Before a noun (attributive): long form прочитанная.
As predicate (describing state): short form прочитана.

minimalPairs.context: _____ дверь ведёт в сад. (attribute before noun)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The open door leads to the garden.

sets.title: Sort and Fill
sets.description: Sort by formation type and fill in correct forms
sets.descriptionRussian: Распределите по типу образования и заполните формы

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these past passive participles by formation pattern

blanks: _____ в прошлом году дом стоит на холме. (The house built last year stands on a hill.)
_____ деньги лежат в конверте. (The received money is in the envelope.)
hints: Before a noun (attributive): use long form, masc nom agreeing with дом.
Predicate (state): short form, masc agreeing with торт.
Before a noun (attributive): long form, plural nom agreeing with деньги.
Predicate (state): short form, plural agreeing with окна.
explanations: Построенный: long form (attributive, masc nom). Before дом: построенный дом.
Съеден: short form (predicative, masc). Торт is the subject, the participle describes its state.
Полученные: long form (attributive, plural nom). Before деньги: полученные деньги.
Закрыты: short form (predicative, plural). Окна is the subject, the participle describes their state.

sets.title: Translate and Build
sets.description: Translate and build sentences with past passive participles

translation.prompt: The letter written by my friend was long.
translation.answer: Письмо, написанное моим другом, было длинным.
translation.hint: written (past passive of написать) = написанное, neuter (письмо).
translation.explanation: Написать → написанное (neuter, agrees with письмо). Agent in instrumental: моим другом.

translation.prompt: The door opened by the wind closed again.
translation.hint: opened (past passive of открыть) = открытая (-т- type), fem (дверь).
translation.explanation: Открыть → открытая (-т- suffix, fem). Agent in instrumental: ветром.

errorCorrection.hint: In predicate position (after subject), use the short form.
errorCorrection.explanation: Predicate position requires short form: работа сделана (not сделанная). Long form goes before nouns.

errorCorrection.sentence: Написана вчера книга лежит на столе.
errorCorrection.hint: Before a noun (attributive), use the long form.
errorCorrection.explanation: Attributive position requires long form: написанная книга (not написана). Short form is for predicates.

errorCorrection.hint: Predicate + neuter noun = short neuter form.
errorCorrection.explanation: Окно (neuter) in predicate requires short neuter form: закрыто (not закрытая, which is fem long).

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: Comprehensive review of past passive participles
sets.descriptionRussian: Комплексный обзор страдательных причастий прошедшего времени

items.hint: -ить verbs with monosyllabic roots → -тый: выпить → выпитый.
items.explanation: Formation: выпить → выпитый (-тый suffix for some -ить verbs with short stems).

items.prompt: Past passive participles are formed from:
items.promptEnglish: What type of verbs form past passive participles?
items.hint: Perfective + transitive = completed result on an object.
items.explanation: Only transitive perfective verbs form past passive participles, expressing a completed result.

items.prompt: _____ результаты были опубликованы. (The received results were published.)
items.explanation: Past passive plural: полученные (agrees with результаты). The results received the action.

items.hint: Predicate = short form (masc, agrees with суп).
items.explanation: Short form predicative: приготовлен (masc, agrees with суп). Describes the soup's state.

items.prompt: решить → решённый. The short form masculine is:
items.promptEnglish: What is the short form masc of решённый?
items.hint: Short form drops one -н- and the ending: решён.
items.explanation: Short form masculine of решённый: решён (keeps the stress on ё).

patternRecognition.question: What do these participles have in common?
options: All are from -ать verbs with -нный suffix
patternRecognition.answer: All are from -ать verbs with -нный suffix
patternRecognition.explanation: All four come from -ать perfective verbs and form the past passive with -нный: написать→написанный, прочитать→прочитанный, etc.

patternRecognition.question: What formation pattern do these share?
patternRecognition.explanation: These all use the -тый suffix, typical of -ыть/-ять/-ить verbs with short stems: открыть→открытый, забыть→забытый, etc.

patternRecognition.question: What do these participles have in common?
options: All are from -ить verbs with -енный/-ённый suffix
patternRecognition.answer: All are from -ить verbs with -енный/-ённый suffix
patternRecognition.explanation: All come from -ить perfective verbs: the -и- drops and -енный/-ённый is added. Some show consonant mutations (п→пл in купленный, с→ш in приглашённый).
